name: Lumen hello
description: The sample plugin of evo-plugin-template: a greeting a project's admin sets, a page where members leave a wave, kept as records of the hub (collection waves, with a level and an audience the admin sets), a route that reads and records the waves, and an MCP tool that greets someone by name.

greeting.title: Greeting
greeting.description: The word the page and the tool greet with.

wave_level.title: Level of a wave
wave_level.description: The level of the project's ladder each wave is kept at (the collection waves). Empty: the level of the project's default label.

wave_audience.title: Audience of a wave
wave_audience.description: everyone: whom the level reaches see the wave; writer: only the person who left it.

routes.name: waves
routes.title: Waves
routes.description: GET answers the project's greeting and its latest waves; POST records a wave, {"name": "..."}.

mcp_tools.name: greet
mcp_tools.title: Greet someone
mcp_tools.description: Greets someone by name with the greeting the project set, and says how many waves the project's page holds.

pages.name: hello
pages.title: Hello
pages.description: The project's greeting and the waves its members left.
